about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Connecting talent with opportunity
about.usDescription: We are a platform dedicated to connecting candidates with companies worldwide. Our mission is to democratize access to employment, helping people find jobs that match their skills, values, and career aspirations. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to showcase their potential and grow professionally in an environment that values their talent.
about.whatDescription: We offer a smart portal where candidates can create detailed profiles, upload their CVs, record presentation videos, and apply to vacancies that match their profile. For companies, we provide tools to post vacancies, search for talent, and manage applications efficiently. All in one place, with a modern and accessible experience.
about.missionDescription: Reduce the gap between talent and job opportunities, creating a transparent ecosystem where candidates and companies connect simply and effectively.
about.valuesDescription: Transparency, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to excellence. Every decision we make is centered on improving our users' experience.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What you need to know about how Trato Directo works
faq.a1: Trato Directo is a staffing platform for the hospitality industry: restaurants, bars, cafés and hotels. We connect people looking for hospitality work (waiters, cooks, bartenders, receptionists, front-of-house staff) with venues that need staff. What sets us apart from a traditional job board is that we assess and verify every candidate before presenting them to a company.
faq.q2: How much does it cost candidates?
faq.a2: It is completely free for candidates, always. Creating your profile, completing the onboarding wizard, applying to vacancies and going through our evaluation process carry no cost or commission.
faq.q3: I'm a company looking for staff. How does it work?
faq.a3: You post your vacancy and see how many people apply, but you don't see the profiles directly. Our team investigates, evaluates and interviews candidates internally, and delivers to you only a shortlist of verified staff suited to the role. You review that shortlist and decide who to hire.
faq.q4: Why doesn't the company see every applicant?
faq.a4: Because that is the value Trato Directo adds. Instead of the company spending time filtering dozens of unverified CVs, we do that work: we check identity, real experience and job references, and only present candidates who fit the vacancy and are verified. The company receives a quality shortlist, not an unfiltered list.
faq.q5: What does the "Verified TD" badge mean?
faq.a5: It's the mark we give a candidate who has passed our verification process: confirmed identity, contacted job references, proven experience and a coherent profile. Only candidates with the "Verified TD" badge are delivered to companies.
faq.a6: Every candidate goes through a multi-stage internal process: background and reference investigation, a skills assessment based on the role, and a team- and culture-fit interview. In addition, a system automatically computes four indices: stability, reliability, evidence and vacancy compatibility.
faq.q7: I'm a candidate. Can I see my score?
faq.a7: Yes. From your dashboard you can see your overall score and your score by category. We don't show the exact formula, to prevent the system from being gamed, but you do know where you stand and what you still need to complete to improve your profile.
faq.q8: What happens to my personal data?
faq.a8: Your data is yours. You can edit or delete your profile whenever you want. Companies never access your data or your identity until Trato Directo delivers you as a verified candidate for a specific vacancy.
faq.q9: How long does my profile stay active?
faq.a9: Your profile stays active and available for selection processes for 12 months. After that you can reactivate it by updating your information; in the meantime it stops appearing in new searches, but your data is not lost.
faq.q10: What languages is the platform available in?
faq.a10: Currently Spanish and English. You can switch languages at any time from the settings menu at the top right.
